SolarAtomizer.description: Transfers all levels of <style="Buff_MachineVengeance">Machine Vengeance</style> from other friendly <style="Mechanical">Mechanical</style> units to <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Belisarius Cawl</style>. Additionally <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Belisarius Cawl</style> faces in one of 6 directions and marks all hexes in a straight line 2 hexes wide. At the beginning of his next turn, deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Melta">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Melta Damage</style> to all enemies on affected hexes.
